resolution: Implemented Ctrl-drag UV marquee selection on the active editor surface. The gesture overrides UV/image dragging, latches after four pixels, draws a cyan area box, and selects only islands whose authored triangle silhouettes cross the signed-workspace rectangle; Ctrl+Shift extends the current set and a click without a drag is inert. The completed island set crosses one typed-array bridge into one validated native face mask and one 3D highlight pass, including empty-selection clearing, so dense selections do not replay whole-model work per island. UV geometry tests pass 41/41, model-paint Zig tests pass 47/47 under Zig 0.16, and the full ReleaseFast editor ship succeeds. Interactive appearance and gesture feel remain for user review.
